description: This file contains setup and configuration code for integrating Telegram into the openclaw project, including helper functions, prompts, and a setup adapter.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAllowFromInput
methods.description: Normalizes input string for Telegram allowFrom, removing prefixes and trimming.

methods.name: parseTelegramAllowFromId
methods.description: Parses a string to determine if it is a valid Telegram numeric ID.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Resolves a list of Telegram allowFrom entries to their IDs, possibly resolving usernames via API.

methods.name: promptTelegramAllowFromForAccount
methods.description: Prompts user to configure Telegram allowFrom list for an account, handling token presence and resolution.
